Expired and failed provider events are audit-only; the 7-day deadline sweep remains the authority and a late successful payment is left for ops reconciliation.
No refund webhooks, receipts, payout accrual or creator transfers yet; refunds remain fake-only and payout tables are schema-only.
Email delivery requires a configured provider; P3 only queues outbox rows and the local acceptance enables the outbox flag to prove they are written.
Live payments require both the stripe provider/secret and the webhook signing secret; without them the checkout and webhook stay inert.
